name: Baidu Comate
desc: Baidu coding assistant that plans before it edits
desc_zh: 先出方案再动手的百度编程助手
solves: Code cannot leave the network, and blind generation is not reviewable. Comate writes the spec and the task list first, changes files only after approval, and can run entirely on your own servers.
solves_zh: 代码出不了内网，多数 AI 编程工具直接出局。Comate 先写文档和任务清单，确认后才动文件，整套可部署在自己的服务器上。
best_for: When the code stays inside a regulated network and reviewers want a plan before any edit.
best_for_zh: 代码要留在受管内网，且希望在改动前先看到一份可审的计划。
notes: Forces a Doc-to-Tasks-to-Changes flow instead of blind generation, and supports fully private deployment for regulated teams. 来源：https://www.infoq.cn/article/ONi9RGciXT9EKSAHNcRz
